catatan: しりょうを コピーして おいて ください. Other orders (コピーして しりょうを おいて…, しりょうを おいて コピーして…) are unnatural. しりょう Bab 15, コピーします Bab 14, ～ておきます Bab 30.

The ★ falls on the only sentence-ending piece (声が聞こえます), so the form alone places it. That is acceptable, but avoid it if another choice exists. 1-3-4-2 (こうえんで 子どもの 遊んで いる 声…, の as the subject marker inside the relative clause) is also natural, with the same ★. Spacing is inconsistent: 声{こえ}が聞{き}こえます has no space, while 遊{あそ}んで いる does.

The ★ falls on the only sentence-ending piece (聞こえません), so the form alone places it. That is acceptable, but avoid it if another choice exists. よく can float (よく 先生の 話が…), and the ★ stays the same. 話 (はなし) Bab 21, 教室 Bab 3.

The ★ falls on the only sentence-ending piece (作ります), so the form alone places it. That is acceptable, but avoid it if another choice exists. ばんごはんを ラジオを 聞きながら 作ります is a possible but slightly awkward scrambling, with the same ★.
The ★ (言って) is fixed by the pattern 言って いただけませんか, which is acceptable. もう一度 and ゆっくり can swap, and the ★ stays the same. Line A does not give the ★ away.

Only logic decides boxes 1 and 3. The reverse (かんじは 書けますが、ひらがなは 書けません, which would put 4 at ★) is grammatical but illogical for a learner, so it is not counted as ganda. Mild risk only. Contrastive は is Bab 27.
The ★ falls on the only sentence-ending piece (持てます), so the form alone places it. That is acceptable, but avoid it if another choice exists. 軽い Bab 12, potential form Bab 27.

tingkat: 店員 is not in the Minna vocabulary list (docs/kb-dokkai/16-kosakata-minna.md lists it under 'Tidak ada di Minna'; Minna uses 店の 人).
catatan: Structurally good: the ★ is unique, and swapping おいしいし and やすいし keeps it on 店員さんも. The only problem is the word 店員, which is outside the Minna vocabulary. 店の 人も would fix it.
友だちに 借りた 本を なくして しまいました. No other natural order. なくします Bab 17, ～てしまいました Bab 29.
わすれて しまいました is a fixed chunk, and the ★ (約束を) follows from たいせつな + noun. This is acceptable. 約束 Bab 9, たいせつ Bab 17.

tingkat: 歩けない is the potential form (可能動詞), which is Bab 27. The item is Bab 26.
catatan: Grammar above the chapter: the item is for ～んです (Bab 26), but the ★ piece 歩けないんです needs the potential form from Bab 27. Also, the ★ falls on the only sentence-ending piece. わたしは can move after いたいから, and the ★ stays the same.
Three の modifiers, but only となりの へやの ラジオの おと is natural. The other permutations (へやの となりの ラジオの, ラジオの となりの へやの, …) are unnatural, so the ★ is unique. おと/聞こえます Bab 27.

Only logic decides boxes 1 and 3. The reverse (昼は 寒いですが、朝は あたたかいです, which would put 3 at ★) is grammatical but goes against both the usual daily temperature pattern and time order, so it is not counted as ganda. Mild risk, like S06. あたたかい Bab 12, contrastive は Bab 27.
